prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1453; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in your insured's claim file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified declarations page confirming those limits and any other coverage that may apply to this loss.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle damage appraisals, repair records, recorded statements, telematics or event data, claim notes, and any dash camera or surveillance footage in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and the steps you will take in response to these requests.
